init_cuda_profiler: init the CUDA profiler with an output file path and optional flags for GPU trace collection
start_cuda_profiling: start the CUDA GPU profiler to begin capturing kernel execution traces
stop_cuda_profiling: stop the CUDA GPU profiler to finalize and flush collected trace data
profile_gpu_code_block: profile a Python code block using the CUDA profiler context manager for automatic start and stop
get_default_profiler_flags: get the default CUDA profiler flags including timestamps, grid size, thread block size, and stream ID
